name: Sonezaki Mikoto
source: The protagonist's underclassman. After seeing him at school during club activities, she had a bit of a crush on him, but hid these feelings once he moved away. But after reuniting with him, these feelings have resurfaced, and she began working at Swallowtail to get closer to him.
